name: plain-writing
description: Makes prose plain and easy to read, with common words, whole sentences, no dashes, no made-up terms and no comparisons. Use it when you write or revise a document, report, summary, README, email, slide, Notion page, commit message or PR description, or when someone asks you to simplify, reword, tighten or clean up text. It also runs for the command `/plain-writing deslopify`, which rewrites an agent reply. Apply it to the words around code and never to the code.
